packets.chronological_placement: Nine years before the Thran-Phyrexian War; Part I, chapters 1?3.
confirmed_events: Halcyon?s mana rig produces powerstones.

confirmed_motivations: Rebbec summons Yawgmoth because Glacian needs treatment.

consequences.text: The wound leads to Yawgmoth?s return and access to Halcyon affairs.

packets.title: Yawgmoth's Arrival
packets.chronological_placement: The Thran, Chapters 2-4
confirmed_events: The Elder Council revokes Yawgmoth's banishment and summons him to Halcyon.
Yawgmoth walks to Halcyon and is welcomed by Rebbec.
Yawgmoth examines Glacian and links the investigation to the Caves of the Damned.
Yawgmoth descends into the caves and finds Gix among the infected.
Yawgmoth begins treating Gix and Glacian as the city watches.
Yawgmoth attends the launch of the floating Thran Temple foundation.
confirmed_relationships: Yawgmoth is Glacian?s physician; Rebbec supports treatment while becoming increasingly conflicted.
confirmed_motivations: Yawgmoth seeks to prove and apply his material study of disease; his ambition is explicit in his response to the summons.

causes.text: The serum program is treatment and coercion; it is not yet the later mass Phyresis program.

consequences.text: The health system becomes a political control mechanism.

chronology_notes: Chapters 2-4 precede the powerstone-phthisis public explanation in Chapter 5 and later institutional escalation.

packets.title: The Uprising and the Crown
packets.chronological_placement: Part II, chapters 13?17.
confirmed_events: Glacian designs weapons while deteriorating.
Gix organizes resistance and Yawgmoth exploits refugee routes.

confirmed_relationships: Gix is a rebel in this phase; Yawgmoth is the state?s medical and military authority.
confirmed_motivations: Yawgmoth publicly frames emergency rule as protection.

causes.text: The transition from rebellion to dictatorship is sequential, not one event.

consequences.text: Yawgmoth becomes ruler of the empire.
